item.title: CHEERIO CELTIC, HALLO COLOGNE
item.description: JAHMAI SIMPSON-PUSEY has seen his season-long loan at Celtic from Manchester City scrapped and is now heading for Germany. The highly-rated 20-year-old defender played just 64 minutes in his time at the champions in the 4-0 win over Kilmarnock at Parkhead in November. Simpson-Pusey came off the radar when Wilfried Nancy arrived early last month [...]

item.title: NANCY AXED IN CLEAR-OUT
item.description: CELTIC have sacked Wilfried Nancy after six defeats in eight games and a month in charge at the champions.
